cells.tense: You are reading what is in front of you right now, and it is landing — the right thing stands out on its own, no argument required.
cells.ask: Give the clarity a shape one person can follow, so what you see becomes something they can use.
cells.core:
Knowing what to attend to works in you the way it is meant to. You walk into a room and the thing that matters shows itself before you can say why, and you have stopped needing the why first. When you do not know yet, that is fine — you can hold an open question without rushing to close it. People can feel the difference: what you point at tends to be the real thing.

That steadiness is free to feed something now. The seeing stays yours and private until it takes a form someone else can hold — so give one of those perceptions a shape: a next step, a sentence, a small structure another person can stand on. Sight that carries weight is what the knowing is for.
cells.sheetLine: You read the room right and don't argue it; give that clear sight a shape others can stand on.
cells.verb: seeing straight through to what matters before you can explain why
cells.place: in the seat of knowing what to attend to

cells.tense: You are bracing for the moment you will finally have gathered enough to say the true thing safely, and that moment keeps moving ahead of you.
cells.ask: Let one honest draw toward what you actually want decide the next step, without checking it first.
cells.core:
The good version of this is simple: something matters, you recognize it before you can explain it, and that recognition is enough to act on. You can trust a read without a file behind it. When this capacity is working, you move on what you see and the explaining comes later, if it comes at all.

Right now the gathering has taken the place of the seeing. Every angle gets checked, every fact gets filed, and none of it settles the question, because the question was never about having enough. Stop amassing proof and follow the pull you already feel — the one that reads as direction rather than doubt — and take one step toward it before you have surveyed the whole map.
cells.sheetLine: You're collecting certainty you'll never finish; follow the pull you already have.

cells.tense: You stood at a door where your own read was not trusted, and you are still standing there, asking other people to confirm what you already knew.
cells.ask: Take one step through uncertainty without waiting for the full road to appear — just enough light to move.
cells.core:
There is a way this goes well: something matters, you sense it before you can name it, and you let that sense guide you without needing it proven first. That is not gone from you. Lately the checking has gotten loud and the knowing has gone quiet underneath it, so you look to someone else's read to tell you whether yours was real.

Work it from the other end. Instead of pushing at the confusion, let yourself imagine forward a little — enough light for the next step only, not the whole road. Walking into a small unknown and finding your footing is what brings the perception back. The read has not left; it is waiting for you to move on it.
cells.sheetLine: Your knowing is buried under checking; step into the next uncertainty with only enough light to move.

cells.tense: You are making choices that turn out right for reasons you cannot trace, and calling it luck while your read does the work behind you.
cells.ask: Name one decision you have made recently and own that you saw it before you reasoned it — set that seeing back where it belongs.
cells.core:
The way this works when it is honored is plain: you notice what matters before you can account for it, and you steer by that noticing. You end up in the right place without a story of how you got there, because the read happened faster than the reasoning did. That is the capacity doing its job.

What has slipped is the claim, not the seeing. Bring one of those moments into the open — pick something you decided and say, plainly, that the sight was yours. Fairness here means giving your own perception its due: the credit has been sitting with coincidence long enough, and handing it back is simpler than the story you have been telling.
cells.sheetLine: Your decisions keep landing right and you call it random; claim the seeing that did it.
